sn35.69:1.1: On one occasion the Venerable Sāriputta and the Venerable Upasena were dwelling at Rajagaha in the Cool Grove, in the Snake’s Hood Grotto.
sn35.69:1.2: Now on that occasion a viper had fallen on the Venerable Upasena’s body.
sn35.69:1.3: Then the Venerable Upasena addressed the bhikkhus thus:
sn35.69:1.4: “Come, friends, lift this body of mine on to the bed and carry it outside before it is scattered right here like a handful of chaff.”
sn35.69:2.1: When this was said, the Venerable Sāriputta said to the Venerable Upasena:
sn35.69:2.2: “We do not see any alteration in the Venerable Upasena’s body nor any change in his faculties;
sn35.69:2.4: ‘Come, friends, lift this body of mine on to the bed and carry it outside before it is scattered right here like a handful of chaff.’”
sn35.69:2.8: ‘I am the eye’ or ‘The eye is mine’;
sn35.69:2.9: ‘I am the ear’ or ‘The ear is mine’ …
sn35.69:2.10: ‘I am the mind’ or ‘The mind is mine,’
sn35.69:2.11: there might be alteration of the body or a change of the faculties.
sn35.69:2.12: But, friend Sāriputta, it does not occur to me,
sn35.69:2.13: ‘I am the eye’ or ‘The eye is mine’;
sn35.69:2.14: ‘I am the ear’ or ‘The ear is mine’ …
sn35.69:2.15: ‘I am the mind’ or ‘The mind is mine,’
sn35.69:2.16: so why should there be any alteration in my body or any change in my faculties?”
sn35.69:3.1: “It must be because I-making, mine-making, and the underlying tendency to conceit have been thoroughly uprooted in the Venerable Upasena for a long time that it does not occur to him,
sn35.69:3.3: ‘I am the eye’ or ‘The eye is mine’; ‘I am the ear’ or
sn35.69:3.5: ‘I am the mind’ or ‘The mind is mine.’”
sn35.69:3.6: Then those bhikkhus lifted the Venerable Upasena’s body on to the bed and carried it outside.
sn35.69:3.7: Then the Venerable Upasena’s body was scattered right there just like a handful of chaff.
